correctness.rationale: Mecke gives exact mean and excess variance through the three-Poisson overlap formula. Polynomials for adjacent/nonadjacent Palm points integrate to I(tau), cross-checked with a rational-polynomial identity valid for all tau. The single-edge Palm interaction is O(1/n) and the union of multi-edge events O(k^4/n^2), yielding a globally summable factorial-moment remainder and count-TV expansion by Cauchy bounds. Pure rational bounds on exponentials prove signs at tau=2,3,4. No finite experiment substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Acceptance band 1–3 neighbors is a natural nonempty-but-not-crowded density filter. It produces an unexpected overdispersion–underdispersion–overdispersion transition with at least two exact Poisson-variance matching crowding scales. At precisely those critical scales the leading signed error cancels and the count approximation accelerates from 1/n to 1/n^2. This motivated parameter phenomenon is not an unmotivated table calculation.
